snippet.title: ShowGuts - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
餅上がれ。

餅が空を飛ぶ正月物理アクションゲーム。
グラップルで掴んで、伸びて、落ちて、また飛ぶ。
重力とお正月に挑む、奇跡のもちもちチャレンジ。

What is Show Guts?

Show Guts is a chaotic climbing game where you control a stretchy piece of omochi — yes, that soft Japanese rice cake — with grappling and an unreasonable dream: reach the heavens before losing your guts.

Climb, swing, and bounce your way through floating present boxes, skyscrapers , and torii gates.  Every fall hurts, every rise feels glorious, and every splat echoes with… sticky determination.
